lines.en: label kirindorm15:
: Hey, Kirin. Are you home right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Kirin。你现在在家吗？

lines.en: I knock on Kirin’s door, hoping to be able to spend some time alone with her tonight.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Kirin 的门，希望今晚能和她单独待一会儿。

lines.en: But, without knowing what Noriko is up to, it’s highly probable that that won’t be happening at all.
lines.zh: 但不知道 Noriko 在忙什么，这事儿大概率是成不了的。

lines.en: That’s not to say I don’t like Noriko either, it’s just-
lines.zh: 倒不是说我不喜欢 Noriko，只是——

lines.en: Kirin seems to function a little differently around me than she does with others.
lines.zh: Kirin 在我身边时的运转方式，看起来和她跟别人在一起时不太一样。

lines.en: Or, who knows? Maybe that’s just something I tell myself to feel special.
lines.zh: 或者，谁知道呢？也许那只是我为了让自己显得特别而编出来骗自己的。

lines.en: : Yup! Feel free to let yourself in, Sensei. Door is always open to you.
lines.zh: : 在！请随便进，老师。这扇门永远为你敞开。

lines.en: scene black
I quickly open the door and let myself into the room.
lines.zh: 我赶紧开门进了屋。

lines.en: The same fruity aroma that greeted me the last time I was here welcomes me with open arms once again.
lines.zh: 上次来时迎接我的那股果香，又一次张开双臂欢迎了我。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu1
And before long, I am facing two cute girls and an upside down house.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我就面对着两个可爱的女孩和一栋上下颠倒的房子。

lines.en: : Excellent timing as always, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 时机一如既往地完美，老师。

lines.en: : Noriko and I were just about to watch a movie.
lines.zh: : 我和 Noriko 正准备看电影呢。

lines.en: : Hey! Have you seen this one before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿！老师，你以前看过这部吗？

lines.en: : They play it on repeat in the old district all the time, but Kirin’s telling me she’s never seen it before.
lines.zh: : 老城区那边一直在反复播，但 Kirin 说她从没看过。

lines.en: : I can't be sure if I’ve seen it if I don’t even know what it’s called.
lines.zh: : 我连它叫什么名字都不知道，怎么能确定自己看没看过。

lines.en: : The weird house certainly doesn’t look familiar to me.
lines.zh: : 那栋奇怪的房子对我来说确实不眼熟。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu2
: Huh...Now that I think about it, I don’t really know what the title is either. But it’s a super weird movie.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这么一说，我也不知道片名是什么。但这是一部超级奇怪的电影。

lines.en: : You’ll probably like it.
lines.zh: : 你大概会喜欢的。

lines.en: : I get why Noriko wants to watch this, but I didn’t take you as the type to be into...abstract movies, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我理解 Noriko 为什么想看这个，但我没想到你也是……会喜欢抽象电影的那类人，Kirin。

lines.en: : I don’t really care. I just want to hang out under the kotatsu and unwind.
lines.zh: : 我其实无所谓。我只是想钻进被炉底下放松一下。

lines.en: : It’s been a pretty long day, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，今天挺累的。

lines.en: : How come it's normal for me to do weird stuff but not normal for Kirin?
lines.zh: : 为什么我做奇怪的事就很正常，Kirin 做就不正常？

lines.en: : I'm not actually weird, am I?
lines.zh: : 我其实不奇怪吧？

lines.en: : Want to maybe join us or something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，要不要一起？

lines.en: : Not sure if you’re aware, but Noriko is kind of crazy about you, so there’s no chance she’d say no.
lines.zh: : 不知道你有没有意识到，Noriko 对你可是相当着迷，所以她绝不可能说不。

lines.en: : All I ask is that there’s no funny business under the table, including any conducted with me.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的请求是别在桌子底下搞事情，包括跟我搞的。

lines.en: : I just spent my entire last paycheck on this kotatsu and I don’t want it to get all gross after just a couple uses.
lines.zh: : 我上一份工资全花在这个被炉上了，我可不想它才用几次就变得脏兮兮的。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu3
: Think you can hold back for an hour or two? Or would you rather go bang on Ayane’s door for some “instant” satisfaction?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能忍一两个小时吗？还是你更想去敲 Ayane 的门，来点“即时”满足？

lines.en: : Stop saying questionable things in front of the girl with the pocket knife.
lines.zh: : 别在那个带折刀的女孩面前说这种可疑的话。

lines.en: : Hm? Did Kirin say something questionable?
lines.zh: : 嗯？Kirin 说了什么可疑的话吗？

lines.en: : My hearing’s not great, so I probably didn’t catch it.
lines.zh: : 我听力不太好，大概没听清。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : But yeah. I wouldn’t mind staying and hanging out here if that’s okay with you two.
lines.zh: : 不过是啊。如果你们俩不介意的话，我倒是不介意留下来一起待着。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu4
: Great! I call shotgun.
lines.zh: : 太好了！我坐副驾。

lines.en: : Hey! I was about to call shotgun!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我正要说副驾呢！

lines.en: : Am I a vehicle now?
lines.zh: : 我现在是辆车了吗？

lines.en: : Yup. Noriko and I are gonna ride you all the way to Mt. Fuji.
lines.zh: : 对。我和 Noriko 要骑着你一路到富士山。

lines.en: : Just not under the kotatsu.
lines.zh: : 就是别在被炉底下。

lines.en: : Shotgun in this context means you have to sit next to me.
lines.zh: : 这里的副驾意思是你要坐在我旁边。

lines.en: : Which you should {i}probably{/i} be thanking me for, since God only knows what would happen over on the crazy side.
lines.zh: : 你{i}大概{/i}该为此感谢我，因为天知道在疯狂那一边会发生什么。

lines.en: : Nothing would happen! I don’t even normally bite!
lines.zh: : 什么都不会发生！我平时甚至都不咬人！

lines.en: : Normally?...
scene kirinkotatsu5
: There’s a time and a place for everything, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 万事都有时间和场合，老师~

lines.en: : You know, I could always just sit in the middle and not offend-
lines.zh: : 你知道，我其实可以就坐在中间，谁也不得罪——

lines.en: : Nope. I called shotgun.
lines.zh: : 不行。副驾是我叫的。

lines.en: : If you break shotgun rules, you have to spend the rest of your life cleaning our room.
lines.zh: : 如果你违反副驾规则，就得用余生打扫我们的房间。

lines.en: : You intend to live here forever?
lines.zh: : 你打算永远住在这儿？

lines.en: Well, actually...it's not like there's really a choice.
lines.zh: 嗯，其实……也没什么别的选择。

lines.en: : Okay, whatever. You have to clean the room until we move out.
lines.zh: : 好吧，随便。那你就得打扫房间直到我们搬走。

lines.en: : Fine. Please forgive me for trying to make everyone happy.
lines.zh: : 行吧。请原谅我试图让所有人都开心。

lines.en: : Making everyone happy never works, Sensei. You’ve gotta pick one person and just focus everything you can on them.
lines.zh: : 让所有人都开心是行不通的，老师。你得挑一个人，然后把你能给的一切都集中在她身上。

lines.en: : I have learned the hard way that you are very much incorrect.
lines.zh: : 我可是吃了苦头才知道，你大错特错。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin twirls around and heads over to the side of the kotatsu opposite Noriko, gracefully sliding herself under the blanket while keeping it lifted up so I can get under as well.
lines.zh: Kirin 转身走到被炉另一边、Noriko 的对面，优雅地把自己滑进毯子底下，同时把毯子掀起来，好让我也能钻进去。

lines.en: I oblige, realizing halfway through entering that I forgot to take my shoes off.
lines.zh: 我照做了，钻到一半才意识到自己忘了脱鞋。

lines.en: I’m glad that Noriko’s love for me apparently surpasses her desire to keep the kotatsu clean, because this is something that I should very much be called out on right now.
lines.zh: 我很高兴 Noriko 对我的爱显然超过了她想保持被炉干净的愿望，因为这种事我现在非常该被骂一顿。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu6
: Comfortable?
lines.zh: : 舒服吗？

lines.en: : Kind of cramped. But I’m pretty large and this isn’t the biggest kotatsu in the world.
lines.zh: : 有点挤。不过我个子挺大，而这也不是全世界最大的被炉。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu7
: Mmmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯！

lines.en: : ...What?
: I don’t like how close you two are.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你们俩靠得这么近。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu8
: Oh, come on. All we’re doing is sitting...
lines.zh: : 哦拜托。我们只是坐着而已……

lines.en: : I agreed to not catch feelings or whatever, but I never said I’d stay six feet away from him for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 我是答应了不产生感情之类的，但我可从没说过要一辈子跟他保持六英尺距离。

lines.en: : I know, but I’m still jealous!
lines.zh: : 我知道，可我还是嫉妒！

lines.en: : And also a little excited because my feet are touching Sensei’s knees right now.
lines.zh: : 而且还有点兴奋，因为我的脚现在正碰着老师的膝盖。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu9
: Those are {i}my{/i} knees.
lines.zh: : 那是{i}我的{/i}膝盖。

lines.en: : Oh my God, why are your knees so big?
lines.zh: : 我的天，你的膝盖怎么这么大？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu10
: Wha- They’re not! They’re normal-sized knees!
lines.zh: : 什——才不是！那是正常尺寸的膝盖！

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. I’ve got tiny knees. They’re like little golf balls that hold my legs together.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我的膝盖小小的。它们就像把我的腿连在一起的小高尔夫球。

lines.en: : Have fun breaking your legs, then! That’s way too small!
lines.zh: : 那你最好玩断腿吧！那也太小了！

lines.en: : Kirin, you really KNEEd to chill out right now. Other people might be sleeping.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你现在真的“膝”需要冷静一下。别人可能还在睡觉呢。

lines.en: : Get it?!
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？！

lines.en: : Because, like-
lines.zh: : 因为，就是——

lines.en: : Knees...
lines.zh: : 膝盖……

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu11
: Hah...
: Oh, come on! That was good!
lines.zh: : 哦拜托！那个很好笑啊！

lines.en: : And what's with these weird matching expressions?!
lines.zh: : 还有你们这同步的奇怪表情是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Are you sure you're not in love?!
lines.zh: : 你们确定自己没有坠入爱河？！

lines.en: : Can we just watch your stupid upside down house movie now?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能现在就看你那部蠢兮兮的倒立房子电影？

lines.en: : You mean the movie that’s been playing the entire time we’ve been talking?
lines.zh: : 你是说那部从我们开始聊天起就一直在放的电影？

lines.en: : I kinda just assumed you didn’t care since you weren’t paying any attention to it.
lines.zh: : 我看你根本没注意它，还以为你不在乎呢。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu12
: Oh. Would you look at that?
lines.zh: : 哦。你瞧瞧。

lines.en: : It actually {i}is{/i} on.
lines.zh: : 它还真{i}在{/i}放啊。

lines.en: : I guess it wouldn't hurt to watch a little bit of it. Especially since you’ve seen it so many times.
lines.zh: : 我想看一小会儿也没什么坏处。毕竟你都看过那么多次了。

lines.en: The three of us direct our attention to the giant glowing rectangle in front of us.
lines.zh: 我们三个把注意力转向面前那个巨大的发光矩形。

lines.en: Somehow or another, and please forgive me for not understanding the science, it channels electricity into moving images.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的——请原谅我不懂这其中的科学——它能把电变成会动的图像。

lines.en: Moving images that...look awfully real for something that is apparently just a movie.
lines.zh: 会动的图像……对一部显然只是电影的东西来说，看起来真实得可怕。

lines.en: There are five girls in a house together, gathered around a small kitchen table.
lines.zh: 有五个女孩在一栋房子里，围坐在一张小餐桌旁。

lines.en: The windows around them are boarded and they’re eating a strange gray substance piled high on their plates.
lines.zh: 她们周围的窗户被木板封死，她们正吃着盘子里高高堆起的某种奇怪的灰色物质。

lines.en: No one is saying or doing anything.
lines.zh: 没有人说话，也没有人做任何事。

lines.en: : Noriko, what the fuck are we watching?
lines.zh: : Noriko，我们到底在看什么鬼东西？

lines.en: : It’s an arthouse film! I think. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 这是一部艺术电影！我觉得是。我也不知道。

lines.en: : It’s weird. I’ve actually never finished it.
lines.zh: : 它很怪。其实我从来没看完过。

lines.en: : Something always comes up in the middle and I have to leave.
lines.zh: : 每次看到一半总会出点事，我就得走开。

lines.en: : It’s like, a {i}really{/i} long movie.
lines.zh: : 就是，一部{i}很长{/i}的电影。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re not just falling asleep?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是只是睡着了？

lines.en: : Of course I’m not falling asleep!
lines.zh: : 我当然没有睡着！

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : I don’t know! Maybe! Just watch! Stuff is gonna happen soon.
lines.zh: : 我不知道！也许是吧！看就行了！马上就要有事情发生了。

lines.en: jump kotatsux
label kotatsux:
scene kotatsuhj1
We continue to focus on the television.
lines.zh: 我们继续盯着电视。

lines.en: It seems as if one of the girls has finished eating before the rest of them.
lines.zh: 看起来其中一个女孩比其他人都先吃完了。

lines.en: Or...actually, wait. Maybe she hasn't?
lines.zh: 或者……等等，实际上，也许她并没有？

lines.en: She stands up and grabs her plate, announcing to the others that she’s tired and is going to head to bed.
lines.zh: 她站起身拿起盘子，跟大家说她累了，要去睡了。

lines.en: A small girl with pink hair, almost the same color as Noriko's, chases after her, clearly upset with the decision.
lines.zh: 一个粉色头发的小个子女孩——发色几乎和 Noriko 一样——追在她后面，显然对这个决定很不高兴。

lines.en: But the one who stood up closes the door in her face, placing her plate of unidentifiable gray food (?) on the floor beside her mattress.
lines.zh: 但那个站起来的女孩当着她的面关上了门，把那盘无法辨认的灰色食物（？）放在床垫旁边的地板上。

lines.en: : What’s that thing in the corner of the room?
lines.zh: : 房间角落里那个东西是什么？

lines.en: : What thing? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么东西？你在说什么？

lines.en: : That big-ass metal tube thing. Do you not see it?
lines.zh: : 那个巨大的金属管子。你没看见吗？

lines.en: : Ooooh, that. Uhh...a water heater, maybe?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，那个啊。呃……也许是热水器？

lines.en: : It’s hard to tell since it’s cut off by the wall.
lines.zh: : 很难说，因为它被墙挡住了。

lines.en: : Huh...
scene kotatsuhj2
: So...when does the stuff start happening?
lines.zh: : 那么……事情什么时候开始发生？

lines.en: A hand finds its way into my lap and I already have a good idea of where this is going.
lines.zh: 一只手摸进了我的大腿之间，我已经很清楚这是要往哪儿发展了。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Noriko. At this rate, your kotatsu is going to be destroyed.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Noriko。照这个速度，你的被炉要被毁了。

lines.en: : Huh...that’s so weird. This is actually a little different than I remember.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好奇怪。这跟我记得的不太一样。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu13
: I mean...it’s been a while since I’ve seen it, though, so I could be misremembering.
lines.zh: : 我是说……不过我已经有一阵子没看了，所以也可能是我记错了。

lines.en: : Actually, is this even the same thing I’ve watched before?
lines.zh: : 其实，这跟我以前看的那个是同一部吗？

lines.en: : The set looks the same and the girls look the same but I could have sworn that last time, they had like...actual food instead of that gray stuff.
lines.zh: : 布景一样，女孩也一样，但我发誓上次她们吃的像是……真正的食物，而不是那种灰色的东西。

lines.en: : But I guess it could just be the coloring of the TV that's making it look that way?
lines.zh: : 不过我想也许只是电视的色调让它看起来那样？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu14
: What do you think, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Kirin？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu15
: I think this movie sucks.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这电影烂透了。

lines.en: : We’ve got Netflix. Why don’t we just watch something on that instead of this weird, arthouse crap?
lines.zh: : 我们有 Netflix。干嘛不随便在上面找点看，非要看这种奇怪的艺术垃圾？

lines.en: Kirin’s hand trails up my thigh to the zipper of my jeans, very slowly pulling it down so it doesn’t make any noise.
lines.zh: Kirin 的手顺着我的大腿摸到我牛仔裤的拉链，非常缓慢地把它拉开，好不发出一点声音。

lines.en: The way that she’s able to hold a conversation while doing this is actually quite impressive.
lines.zh: 她居然能一边做这种事一边维持对话，说实话相当令人佩服。

lines.en: Extremely bold and I guess slightly surprising, but definitely impressive.
lines.zh: 大胆至极，而且我觉得有点令人意外，但绝对令人佩服。

lines.en: scene kotatsuhj3
: Hmm...yeah, I guess if nobody else is enjoying it, we can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，既然没人喜欢看，那我们换一个吧。

lines.en: : That’s so weird, though. It’s usually a lot more intense than this.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪啊。平时它可比这个刺激多了。

lines.en: : Like, this one time, I watched one of the girls straight up hang herself and the others didn’t find out for like, three or four days.
lines.zh: : 比如有一次，我看着其中一个女孩直接上吊自杀了，其他人过了差不多三四天才发现。

lines.en: : Maybe this is just the prequel or something?
lines.zh: : 也许这只是前传什么的？

lines.en: : Sensei, is there anything you want to watch?
lines.zh: : 老师，你有什么想看的吗？

lines.en: : Ooh! I’m interested in hearing your tastes, too.
lines.zh: : 哦哦！我也很想听听你的口味。

lines.en: : I don’t think we’ve talked much about movies yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们还没怎么聊过电影。

lines.en: : Uhh...hello? Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……喂？老师？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu16
: Oh, uhh, sorry. I’m fine with anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃，抱歉。我什么都行。

lines.en: : Hmm...you feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你还好吗？

lines.en: : If you’re a little under the weather, maybe Noriko could run and grab you a bottle of water or something?
lines.zh: : 如果你有点不舒服，要不 Noriko 跑去给你拿瓶水什么的？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu17
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然！

lines.en: : But it looks to me like he could just be suffering from an anxiety attack.
lines.zh: : 不过在我看来，他可能只是焦虑发作。

lines.en: : Before I leave, how about you try closing your eyes and counting to ten? We’ll do some breathing exercises together.
lines.zh: : 在我走之前，你要不要试着闭上眼睛数到十？我们一起做点呼吸练习。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu18
: No...Noriko. I {i}really{/i} think it’s dehydration. It would be {i}very{/i} nice if you were able to get him some water.
lines.zh: : 不……Noriko。我{i}真的{/i}觉得是脱水。你要是能给他拿点水来就{i}太{/i}好了。

lines.en: : Preferably from the vending machine on the ground floor.
lines.zh: : 最好是一楼自动贩卖机的那种。

lines.en: scene kotatsuhj3
: What? Why? There’s one right outside of our door and they just restocked it this morning.
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？我们门外就有一台，而且他们今天早上刚补的货。

lines.en: : I remember specifically because I’ve been craving Coca-Cola ever since my sister’s commercial and I had to wait for them to finish before buying one.
lines.zh: : 我之所以记得特别清楚，是因为自从我姐姐的广告之后我就一直馋可口可乐，而我还得等他们补完货才能买。

lines.en: scene kotatsuhj4
I reach toward Kirin’s lap to return the favor, thinking that I’d be able to remain just as stealthy as she is.
lines.zh: 我伸手向 Kirin 的腿间，想回报她一下，觉得自己能和她一样神不知鬼不觉。

lines.en: However, it is extremely hard to mutually [masturbate] underneath a table while maintaining eye contact with someone uninvolved.
lines.zh: 然而，在桌子底下互相[masturbate]、同时还要和一个无关的人保持眼神接触，实在太难了。

lines.en: And even though this should probably be instilling some sort of nervousness in me, I’m really just more impressed at how easily Kirin was able to pull it off.
lines.zh: 而且虽然这大概该让我有点紧张，但我真的更佩服 Kirin 居然能这么轻松地做到。

lines.en: : Hey...you two just moved closer together, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你们俩刚刚是不是靠得更近了？

lines.en: : Nope. Now, about Netflix.
lines.zh: : 没有。说回 Netflix 吧。

lines.en: : And now your face is getting red...
lines.zh: : 还有你的脸在变红……

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu19
: Then maybe I...need some water as well...{i}Noriko...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那么也许我……也需要点水……{i}Noriko……{/i}

lines.en: : So thirsty.
lines.zh: : 好渴。

lines.en: : Could this be the end for me?
lines.zh: : 这难道就是我的终点了吗？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu20
scene kotatsuhj4
scene kotatsuhj5
: Uhh...
scene kotatsuhj5
: I knew it!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！

lines.en: : That’s...{i}my{/i} penis?
lines.zh: : 那是……{i}我的{/i}阴茎？

lines.en: : I don’t think she’ll buy that the same way she bought the knee thing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不会像买膝盖那套说辞一样买这个。

lines.en: : I knew those knees were too big to actually be yours!
lines.zh: : 我就知道那些膝盖太大了，根本不可能是你的！

lines.en: scene kotatsuhj5
: They {i}were{/i} mine! And they're totally normal knees!
lines.zh: : 那就{i}是{/i}我的！而且是完完全全正常的膝盖！

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu21
: And after I {i}specifically{/i} told you two no funny business under the kotatsu!
lines.zh: : 我明明{i}特意{/i}跟你们说过别在被炉底下搞事情！

lines.en: : What do you have to say for yourself, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你有什么要为自己辩解的吗，Kirin？

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu22
: Are you...you know...
: Going to move your foot?
lines.zh: : 要把脚挪开吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! We had a rule to not do stuff like this in front of each other!
lines.zh: : 当然不！我们明明有规矩说不在彼此面前做这种事！

lines.en: : That’s why I was asking you to go get water specifically from the first floor...
lines.zh: : 所以我才特意让你去一楼接水……

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu21
: I’m obviously not going to just {i}leave{/i} and let you hook up with the man I’m in love with!
lines.zh: : 我显然不会就这么{i}走开{/i}，让你和那个我爱的男人搞在一起！

lines.en: : Have some dignity and do it behind my back! Not in my brand new kotatsu!
lines.zh: : 有点尊严，背着我做！别在我的全新被炉里做！

lines.en: : Oh, and another thing! I-
lines.zh: : 哦，还有一件事！我——

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu23
: Wait, there’s more of it?
lines.zh: : 等等，还有？

lines.en: : Noriko! You’re making it even harder!
lines.zh: : Noriko！你让它更硬了！

lines.en: : Holy shit, it’s bigger than my foot.
lines.zh: : 我操，它比我的脚还大。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu24
: Hehehe...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Does that feel good?
lines.zh: : 感觉舒服吗？

lines.en: : Oh my God. Noriko, just leave.
lines.zh: : 我的天。Noriko，你走吧。

lines.en: : Senseiiiii~
lines.zh: : 老师~

lines.en: : Okay, you need to stop or your kotatsu really will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 好了，你得停下来了，不然你的被炉真的会被毁掉。

lines.en: scene kirinkotatsu25
: Hah...and to think that this is all because Noriko chose to watch some shitty movie when we could have just put on Stranger Things.
lines.zh: : 哈……想想看，这全都是因为 Noriko 非要放这部烂片，而我们本来可以直接放《怪奇物语》的。

lines.en: : Okaaaaay. Bye bye, boner~
lines.zh: : 好——吧。拜拜，小兄弟~

lines.en: : Until we meet again~
lines.zh: : 下次再见~

lines.en: : Or until my roommate stops cockblocking me...
lines.zh: : 或者等我室友不再妨碍我的好事……

lines.en: scene black
Noriko and Kirin both remove their respective appendages from me and I am suddenly stricken by a level of grief that is incomparable to anything else I have ever felt before.
lines.zh: Noriko 和 Kirin 各自把她们的肢体从我身上收了回去，我突然被一种前所未有的悲伤击中。

lines.en: : I feel like there was a much easier solution to this than just stopping in the middle.
lines.zh: : 我觉得比起就这么半途停下，明明有简单得多的解决办法。

lines.en: : There are two beds in here. Why didn’t we use one of those?
lines.zh: : 这里有两张床。我们为什么不用其中一张？

lines.en: : Dude, that’s not the same at all.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，那完全不一样。

lines.en: : It’s really not.
lines.zh: : 真的不一样。

lines.en: : Like, the thrill of getting caught is what makes it hotter. So I applaud Kirin for trying.
lines.zh: : 就是说，会被抓到的刺激感才让它更带劲。所以我还是佩服 Kirin 敢试。

lines.en: : Are we really not continuing?
lines.zh: : 我们真的不继续了吗？

lines.en: : Mm...I’m kind of tired now. I think I'm just going to go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我有点累了。我想我干脆就睡了吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I’m going to go take a shower.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想我去洗个澡。

lines.en: : Why is this happening?
lines.zh: : 为什么会变成这样？

lines.en: : Night, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师！

lines.en: : Oh, and we totally wouldn’t have gotten caught if you didn’t try to finger me. So this was your fault.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你不试图用手指弄我的话，我们根本不会被抓。所以这是你的错。

lines.en: : Ahhh! Shotgun is banned in our room from now on! That should have been me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！从现在起我们房间禁止叫副驾了！那本该是我的！

lines.zh: 我讨厌 Dorm 10。
